Amani Suite
Discover timeless elegance in our air-conditioned Amani Suite where luxury and style meet in harmony. This premium suite features a grand bedroom featuring a 50-inch smart TV and a unique freestanding bathtub overlooking the Indian Ocean, a spacious bathroom with walk in shower, a large living room with sofa lounger and 50-inch smart TV, plus a private balcony. With 24-hour concierge service, hairdryer, minibar, tea and coffee facilities, a safe, 50-inch smart TV, a comfortable work station, soft gowns with slippers, the Amani Suite redefines indulgence as you look out over the Indian Ocean.
